profileEvidence.summary: Cheerful, quick to learn and eager for work, the Cantabrian Water Dog may look composed at rest but becomes lively on the job. On Spain’s northern coast, it helped fishermen recover fallen fish, carry mooring lines between boats and shore, and watch tied-up vessels. Swimming and diving are central to its working tradition; its dense curly coat has an abundant undercoat.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: A cheerful, eager water worker from Spain’s northern ports, with a tradition of retrieving fish and carrying mooring lines.
